title: Big Eye Louis's band at Palms Road House and its cooking
summary: Playing with Big Eye Louis at the Palms Road House, band members cooked and hunted; Big Eye fried rabbit with garlic, and Maurice Durand and Walter Decou were hunters too.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Yes. I did too. I loved rabbit. I sure did boy because I remember when we were playing with Big Eye Louis in New Orleans. And they were great cooks, all of the guys in the band, and huntsmen.

We were playing at Palms Road House and each night some guy would bring something that he had cooked or something like that. And the way old Big Eye Louis could fry rabbit. Boy, and he'd have the garlic all through it, you know. Oh, it was delicious.
And Maurice Decou Durante, he was a great huntsman also. And Walter Decou who was the piano player.
I suppose you could really walk out, I mean it wouldn't be far out of New Orleans before you could go hunting?
In those days. You see all of that country is built up now.
